cc:Work.dc:title: Text and visual leakage across eleven models
cc:Work.dc:description: Mobile layout of Table 4, arXiv:2601.08235v3. Same values as the desktop chart. Visual leakage exceeds text leakage for every model. Lower leakage is better.
